Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our discussion I’m attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the remaining procurement and onboarding milestones so we can get to PO and go-live. Please review and confirm owners/timing.

Key vendor onboarding / procurement milestones (draft):
- Procurement kick-off (Acme) — owner: procurement@acmeretail.com — target: 2026-11-09
- Vendor setup in Ariba/Coupa — owner: Acme procurement — target: 2026-11-16
- Complete vendor forms (W-9, supplier questionnaire) — owner: Acme legal/procurement — target: 2026-11-12
- Submit banking/ACH details (secure portal) — owner: Acme finance — target: 2026-11-12
- Redwood supplier onboarding (internal review & account setup) — owner: Marissa Cole (Vendor Ops) — target: 2026-11-15
- Issue trial PO (first month) / invoicing cadence confirmation — owner: Acme procurement & Redwood finance — target: 2026-11-20
- Target contract signature / PO issuance — owner: Alex Johnson / Redwood sales — target close date: 2026-11-30

Dependencies / notes:
- If Acme requires Ariba punchout or specific form ID, please flag ASAP (may add 1-2 weeks).
- Net payment terms (e.g., NET-30 vs NET-60) will affect finance review timeline.

Attachments: MAP-AcmeRetail-Draft-20261103.xlsx (attached) — contains milestone table with responsibilities and acceptance criteria.

Ask:
1) Confirm primary procurement contact and whether Acme uses Ariba or Coupa for vendor onboarding.
2) Confirm who will provide W-9 and banking details and the channel (secure upload/portal or email).
3) Any internal compliance/PO requirements we should add to the MAP?

Happy to hop on a short sync with procurement next week if helpful — I’ll defer scheduling until I get confirmation of owners.

Best,
Dylan Brooks

Thanks Dylan — good recap and useful MAP.

Quick answers: we use Ariba for vendor onboarding. I’m looping in procurement@acmeretail.com (procurement lead) and Samantha Lee (finance) to own the forms and banking details. Procurement will start the kick-off next Monday (2026-11-09).

We’ll:
- Fill out the vendor form in Ariba and push W-9 via secure upload (I’ll attach a copy here for reference).
- Finance (Samantha) will provide ACH/banking details via our secure vendor portal (we won’t email bank details).
- Procurement note: we typically require NET-60 for new vendors; hope we can discuss NET-30 but expect finance review time if we try to shorten.

I’ve attached a current W-9 (W-9_AcmeRetail.pdf) for your records; final signed will be uploaded to Ariba.

Best,
